items.prompt: Why do closed file handles and a clean child exit not prove a durable account update?
items.modelAnswer: They establish resource/completion behavior only for the shown process/file interface. Actual update integrity needs validated source/schema, expected status/data, commit/fsync/transaction and recovery/reconciliation policies, permissions and concurrency control. Local cleanup/exit alone does not show crash persistence or business correctness.

criteria.text: Separates resources/status from durable business state.
Keeps platform and data-validation scope explicit.
